Unser Mandant ist ein international erfolgreiches, mittelständisch geprägtes Industrieunternehmen mit hoher technologischer Kompetenz und anspruchsvollen Kundenprojekten. Das Unternehmen entwickelt und produziert komplexe, kundenspezifische Lösungen für internationale Märkte und zählt in seinem Segment zu den etablierten Anbietern.
Im Zuge des weiteren Wachstums suchen wir im exklusiven Auftrag einen erfahrenen Senior Cost Engineer / Kalkulator (gn) . In dieser Schlüsselposition verantworten Sie die wirtschaftliche Bewertung anspruchsvoller Produkte und Projekte, entwickeln belastbare Kostenmodelle und schaffen fundierte Entscheidungsgrundlagen für Vertrieb, Engineering und Management.
Aufgaben
Eigenverantwortliche Erstellung wirtschaftlicher Kalkulationen und Kostenanalysen für anspruchsvolle Kunden- und Entwicklungsprojekte
Analyse technischer Unterlagen sowie Ableitung wirtschaftlicher Fertigungs- und Umsetzungskonzepte
Ermittlung und Bewertung von Herstellkosten unter Berücksichtigung relevanter Material-, Fertigungs-, Beschaffungs-, Logistik- und Gemeinkosten
Entwicklung transparenter Entscheidungsgrundlagen für Vertrieb, Projektmanagement und Management
Durchführung von Wirtschaftlichkeitsanalysen sowie Bewertung von Produkt- und Prozessänderungen hinsichtlich ihrer Kostenwirkungen
Durchführung von Nachkalkulationen sowie Analyse von Plan-Ist-Abweichungen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Kalkulationsqualität
Identifikation von Kostenpotenzialen sowie Entwicklung wirtschaftlicher Handlungsalternativen in enger Abstimmung mit den Fachbereichen
Pflege und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung von Kalkulationsmethoden, Kostenmodellen und relevanten Kalkulationsgrundlagen
Fachliche Unterstützung angrenzender Unternehmensbereiche bei kostenrelevanten Fragestellungen sowie strategischen Investitions- und Beschaffungsentscheidungen
Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Vertrieb, Engineering, Einkauf, Produktion, Supply Chain und Controlling
Qualifikation
Erfolgreich abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung mit entsprechender Weiterbildung (z. B. Techniker) oder ein Studium im Bereich Maschinenbau, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Produktionstechnik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung
Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Cost Engineering, in der technischen Kalkulation oder Produktkostenkalkulation eines produzierenden Industrieunternehmens
Fundiertes Verständnis industrieller Fertigungsprozesse sowie komplexer Kosten- und Wertschöpfungsstrukturen
Sicherer Umgang mit technischen Zeichnungen, Stücklisten und technischen Dokumentationen
Erfahrung im Umgang mit ERP-Systemen sowie sehr gute Kenntnisse in MS Excel; Erfahrung mit Kalkulations- oder BI-Tools ist von Vorteil
Analytische Denkweise, ausgeprägtes Zahlenverständnis und eine strukturierte, selbstständige Arbeitsweise
Kommunikationsstärke sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexe wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge verständlich aufzubereiten und bereichsübergreifend zu vermitteln
Fließende Deutsch- sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Eine verantwortungsvolle Schlüsselposition mit hohem Gestaltungsspielraum und direktem Einfluss auf wirtschaftliche Entscheidungen
Ein innovatives, international ausgerichtetes Industrieunternehmen mit langfristiger Perspektive
Hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit der Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten
Flexible Arbeitszeiten und eine moderne Arbeitsumgebung
Anspruchsvolle technische Produkte und abwechslungsreiche Projekte
Kurze Entscheidungswege sowie eine offene und wertschätzende Unternehmenskultur
Individuelle fachliche und persönliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
Attraktive Vergütung sowie ein modernes Leistungspaket
Interesse geweckt?
Sie möchten Ihre Erfahrung im Cost Engineering in einem technologisch anspruchsvollen Umfeld einbringen und aktiv zur wirtschaftlichen Weiterentwicklung eines erfolgreichen Industrieunternehmens beitragen?
Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung oder eine erste vertrauliche Kontaktaufnahme.

A Career at HARMAN
As a technology leader that is rapidly on the move, HARMAN is filled with people who are focused on making life better. Innovation, inclusivity and teamwork are a part of our DNA.

When you add that to the challenges we take on and solve together, you’ll discover that at HARMAN you can grow, make a difference and be proud of the work you do every day. About the Role The Director, Cost Engineering & Sustainability defines and executes cost and sustainability engineering strategy across HARMAN's Automotive division.

The created strategy is used to define overall profitability, sustainability, and growth goals for HARMAN AUTOMOTIVE.

The role is responsible for reaching the defined goals by driving cross-functional implementation of Technical and Commercial measures in collaboration with, mainly but not exclusively with, Procurement, Engineering, Customer Account Management, Manufacturing, and Suppliers.

The role is responsible for optimizing a multibillion-dollar spend and is expected to deliver benchmark performance & defined sustainability goals over multiple years to enable divisional-level growth results. The role reports into Best Cost Analytics in the Strategic Procurement and Partnering Function of our global Operations.

Your Team This position will report to the VP, Best Cost Analytics lead, and will have a global team of 15 direct reports, leading cost improvement strategy and execution from multiple stakeholder groups. What You Will Do
Establish the vision, goal, framework, processes, and methods needed to enable profitability, sustainability, and growth goals with highly accurate cost/ CO2e modeling (TCO) across the entire HARMAN Automotive division (all products, regions, and customers)
Establish the vision for Lifecycle Assessment of emissions (CO2e) and build capabilities to achieve carbon neutrality per Harman Automotive Sustainability objectives
Define divisional profitability, sustainability goal, and execution strategy in respective areas (see above) with senior leadership of the division
Develop, align, and execute division-wide strategy to assemble and enable highly effective cross-functional teams, including Procurement, Engineering, Manufacturing, and Account Management, which create overarching profitability, sustainability strategies, and deliver commercial and technical measures.
Build and enroll strategy with the executive leadership team of HARMAN and Suppliers to identify a framework for reaching cost transparency and the best cost that ensures HARMAN's overall competitiveness in the market.
Support the Make versus buy analysis process for Controlling, category, and the Operations organization
Define and deliver advanced sourcing, design to cost, CO2e reduction & manufacturing and sourcing strategy of current and new HARMAN products in close collaboration with state-of-the-art supply chain partners
Create and execute a supplier and customer cost negotiation strategy with Procurement and Customer Account teams
Ensure day-to-day development and delivery of cost & CO2e models by establishing required processes and methods to drive consistent practices within the cost engineering team and reflecting industry best practices. This includes the processes necessary to keep the cost & CO2e models up to date with current information and best known methods.
Develop synergy programs within the Samsung group to leverage scale in business
Lead Component Engineering effort across the Division to create a component library that meets HARMAN Automotive’s long-term product strategy, profitability, sustainability, and growth
Build a development strategy of internal teams to reach a cost-conscious mindset across all teams of the Automotive division
Lead, Coach, and Develop staff and through training and succession planning processes to maximize their potential for the benefit of the individual and company
What You Need
Minimum 15+ years of experience in Cost Engineering /Sustainability/ VM / Procurement or Manufacturing / Engineering, preferably in the Automotive industry
Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Business Administration, or Economy
Minimum 10+ years of experience in cost engineering / VM / design to cost/manufacturing
Minimum 10+ years of experience and ability to lead diverse global teams to improve profitability, sustainability, growth, innovation, and time to market commitments
Proven experience with scientific expertise in Semiconductor as it’s related to chip, device, modem, memory device; more than 10 years in the Semiconductor Industry
Proven track record of outstanding engaging skills in diverse, cross-functional teams, including executive stakeholders, to embrace continuous improvement in a highly competitive environment
Strong negotiation and relationship-building skills.

Master’s degree
Experience with automotive electronics is highly desirable
Demonstrated ability to build cross-functional collaboration models that identify and implement improvements in the area of sourcing, design, and manufacturing in automotive electronics
Experience in corporate-level design to cost/manufacturing programs
Proven team player with excellent communication, collaboration, and interpersonal skills
Change Orientation: Able to adapt to changing demands and conditions
German, Chinese, and/or Hungarian Language skills are a plus
What Makes You Eligible
Be willing to travel up to 20%, domestically and internationally
Be willing to work in an office in Novi, MI or work remotely full-time with occasional trips to all HARMAN locations (this could be on 24-hour notice)
Successfully complete a background investigation and drug screen as a condition of employment (US Only)

Flexible work environment, allowing for full-time remote work globally for positions that can be performed outside a HARMAN or customer location
Access to employee discounts on world-class Harman and Samsung products (JBL, HARMAN Kardon, AKG, etc.)
Extensive training opportunities through our own HARMAN University

# Value and Cost Engineer #

Haag, St. Gallen, CH
Employment Type: Permanent
**About VAT Group**
At VAT, we change the world with vacuum solutions. As the world-s leading supplier of high-performance vacuum valves, we have been driving innovation for more than 60 years.

With over 3,200 employees worldwide, we operate from our headquarters in Haag, Switzerland, with manufacturing sites in Switzerland, Malaysia and Romania, as well as sales and service hubs around the world. We are guided by our passions integrity, teamwork, customer centricity, and innovation - always working together as \#oneVAT.
Joining us means becoming part of a passionate, international team where your voice is heard, your ideas matter, and your career growth is supported.
**Value and Cost Engineer**

* Lead cost estimation activities including should-cost, cost modelling, and top-down/bottom-up analyses for engineered products
* Conduct detailed cost analyses and validate supplier cost breakdowns and manufacturing processes
* Support sourcing activities for Design-to-Cost projects to ensure cost-effective outcomes
* Identify and support Value Added/Value Engineering (VA/VE) opportunities to optimize total product cost
* Analyze tools and part costs for mechanical and electronic components and maintain cost databases
* Provide analytical input for supplier negotiations through fact-based insights and benchmarks
* Conduct cost audits to validate accuracy, transparency, and compliance with expected cost structures
* Identify cost-reduction opportunities and efficiency improvements at suppliers
* Develop cost models to support product design early in development (Design-to-Cost, DfM, DfSC)
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Engineering, Procurement, Sales) to gather data and assess risks
* Provide regular reporting on cost saving initiatives and support central decision-making (target costing, benchmarking, make-or-buy analysis, budgeting)

* Technical background in mechanics, mechanical engineering, production engineering, or similar
* Degree in Mechanical Engineering HF/FH or equivalent
* Over 5 years of experience in cost engineering, development, value engineering, or strategic procurement
* Demonstrated experience with cost modelling and supplier cost analysis
* Experience working in complex global organizational environments
* Background in machinery, vacuum technology or semiconductor-related production is beneficial
* Experience coordinating cross-functional or category-focused teams
* Solid project management experience
* Strong skills in Microsoft Excel; PowerBI is an advantage
* Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Ability to influence outcomes through expertise (without direct authority)
* Ability to manage multiple priorities
* Strong risk-based analytical approach
* Effective collaboration and stakeholder management
* Fluent in English; good German is preferred (or alternative profile: strong German + B1 English)
**Our commitment to inclusion, fairness and equal opportunities**
We believe in meaningful careers, continuous learning, and equal opportunities for everyone to drive our innovation and success. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are dedicated to fostering an inclusive and respectful workplace. If you have concerns, our compliance channel is available at our website. All reports are handled with strict confidentiality and in accordance with our Code of Conduct.

## Vos responsabilités ##

* Diriger des projets transversaux au sein de l'environnement de contrôle pour promouvoir des solutions et processus innovants.

## Votre profil ##
* Formation solide en gestion d'entreprise, idéalement avec un Diplôme Fédéral Suisse en Finance et Comptabilité ou une qualification équivalente.
* Au moins cinq ans d'expérience professionnelle en contrôle, de préférence dans le secteur de la construction.
* Une expérience en gestion fonctionnelle ou hiérarchique d'employés est un avantage.
* Esprit analytique avec une forte affinité pour les chiffres et une approche structurée et orientée solutions du travail.
* Excellentes compétences en communication, personnalité affirmée, orienté résultats et potentiel de leadership.
* Connaissance d'Abacus et des outils BI est un atout.
* Maîtrise de l'allemand et de l'anglais au niveau C1 ou supérieur.
* Seules les candidatures directes de candidats résidant déjà en Suisse avec un permis de travail suisse valide seront prises en compte.
## Notre offre ##
Un rôle clé avec une grande visibilité dans la fonction finance d'une entreprise en croissance
Possibilité de façonner l'innovation dans le contrôle et la digitalisation
L'opportunité de prendre la direction du Contrôle de Projet à moyen terme
Un environnement dynamique, international dans un secteur tourné vers l'avenir
Conditions de travail modernes et conditions d'emploi attractives
Si vous êtes prêt à contribuer à notre contrôle de projet et à franchir la prochaine étape de votre carrière, nous attendons votre candidature avec impatience.
## Vous êtes partant ##
Nous attendons avec impatience des candidatures de toutes sortes - le (a) signifie diversité, même dans notre intitulé de poste.
Nous n'acceptons les dossiers des agences de recrutement qu'après consultation. Merci de ne pas soumettre de dossiers sans nous consulter. Sinon, nous considérerons ces candidatures comme des candidatures directes.

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.
Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

As Group Cost Controller at Harmattan AI, you will take ownership of the Group’s Industrial, R&D & other operational costing, working closely with the FP&A Manager to structure, develop, and continuously improve Industrial P&L, Cost performance monitoring, and decision-support capabilities across multiple entities.
The role combines hands-on analytical execution with higher-level structuring responsibilities, including Industrial P&L creation & development, Industrial & R&D cost planning, budgeting, forecasting, and KPI definition.

Build the industrial P&L and the costing framework. Create the industrial P&L, define the standard cost calculation methodology, and set up the performance tracking processes that go with it.
Monitor and challenge production and inventory performance. Track production costs, inventory levels and variances, identify deviations early, and work with operations to close them.
Run the industrial management cycles. Initiate and own monthly closings, business reviews, forecasts and budgets for the industrial scope.
Contribute to the Odoo implementation. Work with Production and Supply Chain to ensure inventory is tracked reliably in the system and that the outputs the business needs come out of it.
Drive cost visibility and optimization beyond the plant. Follow R&D and project costs, and lead cost optimization initiatives across other operating costs.

Educational Background: Finance, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field (Master’s preferred)
Industrial Controlling Expertise: 5–8 years in cost or industrial controlling within a manufacturing environment or a complex production environment

Builder's Mindset & Adaptability: Has built a controlling framework from a blank page rather than inherited one. Autonomous, structured, and at ease in a fast-moving environment where the answer does not exist yet.
Business Partnering & Communication: A true business partner — curious about operations, comfortable on the shop floor, able to challenge production, engineering and procurement constructively. Fluent in French and English.
We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.
